title: The Big Gundown
description: Lawman John Corbett (Lee Van Cleef) searches the U.S.-Mexico border for a Mexican peasant (Tomas Milian) accused of raping and killing a 12-year-old girl.

title: Good Day for a Hanging
description: The new marshal (Fred MacMurray) is the only one in town who thinks a charming killer (Robert Vaughn) should hang.

title: King of the Wild Horses
description: A mustang stallion runs swiftly to the rescue when the boy who befriended him is endangered.

title: Cowboy
description: A Chicago hotel desk clerk (Jack Lemmon) talks a trail boss (Glenn Ford) into taking him on a cattle drive to Mexico.

title: Western Code
description: Tim Barrett, a renowned lawman, rescues Patty from a ruffian and saves her brother from being lynched.

title: Jack McCall, Desperado
description: During the Civil War, a Southerner joins the Union Army and is accused of leaking information to the Confederates.

title: Relentless
description: Framed for a murder he didn't commit, a cowboy hides with a traveling woman as he flees a sheriff and hunts for the real killer.

title: 3:10 to Yuma
description: A rancher (Van Heflin) needing cash is hired to put an outlaw (Glenn Ford) on the train to Yuma prison.

title: Wyoming Renegades
description: An ex-convict (Phil Carey) and his girlfriend (Martha Hyer) cannot start over until they stop Butch Cassidy's (Gene Evans) gang.

title: Blackjack Ketchum, Desperado
description: A gunfighter (Howard Duff) wants peace in the valley, but a cattle baron (Victor Jory) and his brothers want war.

title: The Guns of Fort Petticoat
description: An Army deserter (Audie Murphy) shows defenseless Texas women how to hold off Indians out to avenge a massacre.

title: Go West, Young Girl!
description: New England writer Netty and cavalry widow Gilda team up to find Billy the Kid.

title: Ten Wanted Men
description: An Arizona rancher (Randolph Scott) protects his empire from a rival landowner (Richard Boone) and his hired guns.

title: Gunman's Walk
description: A rugged rancher (Van Heflin) with good and bad sons can only stop his bad son (Tab Hunter) with a gun.

title: Ride Lonesome
description: A bounty hunter's need for vengeance emerges when he learns the outlaw he's escorting is related to his wife's killer.

title: Battle of Rogue River
description: A cavalry major (George Montgomery) makes peace with Indians despite an agitator (Richard Denning) working for carpetbaggers.

title: Three Hours to Kill
description: The inhabitants of a small western community turn on Jim Guthrie (Dana Andrews) when he becomes the prime suspect for a murder he didn't commit.

title: The Desert Horseman
description: The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) catch up to payroll robbers.

title: The Last Posse
description: A posse led by an alcoholic sheriff pursues the Drune family after they rob a wealthy rancher. Several days later, the Drunes are all dead, the sheriff is wounded, and the money has disappeared.

title: The Stranger Wore a Gun
description: A man whose life was saved by an outlaw shows his gratitude by reluctantly assisting in a stagecoach robbery.

title: Men Without Law
description: Returning from the war, Buck gets caught by Murdock, who takes his letter of introduction to the Del Reys. Posing as Buck, Murdock takes Del Ray's jewels and his daughter Jaunita. To rescue Juanita, Buck poses as Murdock.

title: Arizona
description: A drifter (William Holden) and the cavalry help the first woman (Jean Arthur) in Tucson protect her freight line from Indians.

title: Fury at Gunsight Pass
description: One bank robber (David Brian) double-crosses another (Neville Brand), giving the undertaker and others a chance at the loot.

title: Al Jennings of Oklahoma
description: Lawyer Al (Dan Duryea) and brother Frank (Dick Foran) turn to robbing banks and trains after Union troops raid their home.

title: The New Daughters of Joshua Cabe
description: A framed sheriff (John McIntire) is about to hang, but his bogus wayward daughters have a plan.

title: They Rode West
description: The new doctor (Robert Francis) at a cavalry fort finds resentment at first, even more once he treats Indians.

title: The Last Frontier
description: Three trappers become scouts for a cavalry captain (Guy Madison) who loses his fort to a hated colonel (Robert Preston).

title: White Eagle
description: An Indian pony-express rider C1 catches post-Civil War horse thieves.

title: The Mountain Men
description: Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.

title: Decision at Sundown
description: A gunman (Randolph Scott) rides into Sundown for a showdown with the big shot (John Carroll) he blames for stealing his wife.

title: The Last Rebel
description: Two Confederates (Joe Namath, Jack Elam) save a man's (Woody Strode) life and cause trouble in 1865 Missouri.

title: The Avenger
description: Mysterious Mexican rider the Black Shadow (Buck Jones) hunts down the outlaws who killed his brother.

title: The Texican
description: A fugitive lawman (Audie Murphy) leaves Mexico to get the Texas saloon boss (Broderick Crawford) who framed him and killed his brother.

title: The Kid From Broken Gun
description: A masked avenger (Charles Starrett) tries to help an innocent man (Jack Mahoney) accused of murder.

title: The Tall T
description: An outlaw (Richard Boone) and his men hold an heiress (Maureen O'Sullivan), her cowardly husband and a rancher (Randolph Scott).

title: 7th Cavalry
description: Absent from Custer's Last Stand, an Army captain (Randolph Scott) volunteers for the Little Bighorn burial detail.

title: Laramie Mountains
description: The Durango Kid learns that crooked scouts are behind attempts to escalate a war between a local tribe and the cavalry.

title: Last of the Comanches
description: A cavalry sergeant (Broderick Crawford) leads soldiers, civilians and an Indian (Johnny Stewart) on a desert trek.

title: Comanche Station
description: Three outlaws join a loner (Randolph Scott) and another man's wife (Nancy Gates), who was kidnapped by Indians.

title: The Great Sioux Massacre
description: The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).
